//: Type-checking only. There is no build step and there must not be one:
@updateURL/@downloadURL point every installed user at flyt.user.js in this
repo, so that file is the shipping artifact, not a source input. noEmit is
the whole point — tsc reads the same bytes the browser runs.
strictNullChecks is off deliberately. This is DOM-heavy code where almost
every querySelector legitimately returns null and is guarded by shape, not
by a check tsc can see; turning it on buys hundreds of false positives and
none of the bugs this project actually has. What IS on catches the two
classes that have really bitten us: arithmetic on non-numbers (a stray
backtick once turned the whole 4000-line CSS template into NaN) and
block-scoped variables used before declaration (the bare-CSS trap).
